svg.aria-label: An ARTEX console announces itself. The shipped favicon.ico is 15,086 bytes, Shodan mmh3 hash -576220750, SHA-256 8b567c02 through a589856b. The page title is ARTEX followed by the Chinese for autonomous penetration-testing console. GET /api/health answers without a login with ok true, service artex and the version. The console listens on 8787 and the intercept proxy on 8788, bound to localhost in the compose file; 8787 is also RStudio Server's default. Search with Shodan http.favicon.hash:-576220750 or FOFA icon_hash equals -576220750, and on your own networks with find_artex_console.py. Researchers counted 609 hosts in October (Unit 42), 1,465 hosts on 4 November (Censys), more than 1,600 exposed consoles in early November (cited by the FBI) and 969 live consoles across 11 fork families (ReversingLabs, 18 November), mostly on PEG Tech, UFO/B2-Net, Yancy, Tencent, Alibaba and Host-Baltic.
